source: Manual archaeology pass over Realmz dungeon source and local Oracle output
realmzBitIndexConvention: MyrBitTstShort(&value, b) maps source bit index b to mask 1 << (15 - b).

sourceAnchors.finding: Dungeon movement and plotwall consume the same Data DL field bits.
Dungeon search checks mask 0x0F00, then sets bit index 9 and bit index 2.
Dungeon note creation sets or clears bit index 10 on the current dungeon cell.
Perspective walls, doors, arches, stairs, and pillars are derived from dungeon field bits.
Dungeon combat maps reduce field bits to wall/floor/black/default terrain.

bitFlags.label: dungeon encounter / Action Point trigger marker

runtimeMasks.label: directional secret/pass-through group
runtimeMasks.notes: Search checks this mask before setting revealed marker and arch bits.

runtimeMasks.label: dungeon combat hole group
runtimeMasks.notes: After clearing the arch/path marker, combatmap treats this mask as cells that use floor-like combat expansion instead of wall expansion.

runtimeMasks.label: door orientation group
runtimeMasks.notes: Movement sound logic treats either door bit as a door.

editorImplications: Model Data DL as a DungeonCellProfile bitfield, not a terrain tile ID.
Provide named dungeon drawing primitives before exposing raw masks.
Treat secret pass-through as directional, not as a single secret toggle.
Route dungeon notes and Action Point trigger markers through their dedicated workflows where possible.
Treat visible arch/revealed markers and hidden visual markers as runtime-sensitive until Divinity writer fixtures clarify author defaults.
Require writer fixtures before enabling broad dungeon geometry edits.
